info.description: Single-storefront e-commerce API (users, catalog, cart, orders, payments).
info.title: Malawi E-Commerce Store API

delete.description: Children become roots (SET NULL), they are not deleted.

patch.description: Slug is immutable. Pass clear_parent to detach to root.

post.description:
Multipart upload. Queued in River, processed to Cloudinary
async — answers 202 immediately, image appears once the
worker finishes. Omit the file entirely if no image.
Idempotent: confirming twice succeeds.
post.summary: Confirm an order's holds into sales (admin)

post.description: Idempotent: releasing twice succeeds.
Holds lines atomically; short lines fail the whole order.

get.description:
With variantIds, returns one row per variant (comma lists or
repeated query params, cap MAX_BULK_ITEMS) plus the ids that do
not resolve to a variant. Without variantIds the single
product_id read is unchanged.

post.description:
Per-item results; HTTP 200 for a processed batch. With
atomic=true every line commits or the whole batch rolls back.
post.summary: Set on-hand stock for many SKUs (admin)

post.description:
Per-item results in a 200 envelope. Duplicate generated slugs
reject the whole request; a DB slug collision is per item.
dryRun validates and projects the rows without writing.

patch.description:
One partial patch per product; slug stays immutable. An empty
patch is a per-item validation error. Duplicate ids reject the
whole request; dryRun projects without writing.

post.description:
Max 25 ids. Products referenced by order history are blocked
per item (CONFLICT); variants, gallery, inventory, carts and
wishlists cascade. dryRun reports wouldDelete and blockers
without writing.

delete.description: Hard delete — variants cascade. Prefer deactivating.

patch.description: Slug is immutable. Pass clear_category to unfile.

post.description: Multipart upload via the River queue (202 immediately).

get.description: Includes rows whose upload is still queued (empty url).

post.description: Multipart with repeated files (field "files"; "file" is also accepted). Each file becomes one River job, so the response returns before Cloudinary finishes. The gallery fills in as uploads complete; when the product has no primary image, the first ready image is promoted to image_url automatically.

parameters.description: Images (max 10 MiB each, up to 20 per request)
parameters.name: files

delete.description: If the row was the product's primary image, the next ready image is promoted; with no images left, image_url is cleared.

put.description: Points products.image_url (the storefront primary) at one gallery row. Pending uploads are rejected.

get.description: Admin user directory: search, role/verification filters and paging.

parameters.description: Created at or after (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Created at or before (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: created_before

patch.description: Single-storefront admin op. Requires the admin role.

One partial patch per variant; product_id and sku stay
immutable. An empty patch is a per-item validation error.
Duplicate ids reject the whole request. Availability is read
before writes; dryRun projects without writing.

post.description: Verifies credentials and returns a JWT. Errors stay vague on purpose.
Always succeeds (unknown emails too — no enumeration).
Consumes the token, sets the password, revokes sessions.
Reusing a consumed token kills the whole session chain.
post.summary: Rotate into a fresh token pair

post.description: Creates the account (customer by default, admin for ADMIN_EMAILS) and returns a JWT.
Always succeeds (unknown emails too — no enumeration).

get.description:
One page of active-cart lines with snapshot prices. Subtotals
always cover the whole cart. Sends {"data": Cart, "meta": …}.

post.description: Validates against the catalog and snapshots the price.

Max 25 lines. Identity comes from the JWT. Duplicate
product/variant lines reject the whole request. Non-atomic
batches report invalid lines per item and keep going; atomic
batches validate first and write all lines in one transaction.
The response carries the full updated cart.

get.description:
Public storefront taxonomy, flat and ordered by name.
Ships {"data": [rows], "meta": {page, limit, offset, total, total_pages, has_next, has_prev}}.

parameters.description: Only categories with active products (false = empty only)
parameters.name: has_products

get.description: Pretty-URL lookup used by the storefront.

Caller's orders with paging and filters, newest first.
Sends {"data": [orders], "meta": {page, limit, …}}.

parameters.description: Created at or after (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Created at or before (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: created_before

post.description: Freezes the cart into a pending order, reserves stock, clears the cart.
Releases the stock hold. Pending orders only.
Returns a URL for Stripe's hosted checkout page for the owned pending order.
post.summary: Create a hosted Stripe Checkout session

post.description: Validates ownership, converts legacy MWK totals to USD, reuses pending intents.

get.description:
Lightweight catalog rows (no variants — fetch Detail per product).
Ships {"data": [rows], "meta": {page, limit, offset, total, total_pages, has_next, has_prev}}.

parameters.description: Full-text search over name, description and slug (word prefixes; substring fallback)
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Restrict to product ids (comma separated or repeated, max MAX_BULK_ITEMS)
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description: Only products with sellable stock (false = out of stock only)
parameters.name: in_stock

parameters.description: Variant size name, e.g. XS, M, XL
parameters.name: size

parameters.description: Created at or after (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Created at or before (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD)
parameters.name: created_before

get.description: Pretty-URL lookup used by the storefront.
Product + its variants (the storefront product page).

Public page: average/count over every review, newest-first
review page. Ships public.Summary with meta counters.

post.description: One review per user per product — edit to change it.

get.description: Public SKU list for the storefront product page.

post.description:
Per-item results in a 200 envelope. The product must exist
(whole-request 404). SKUs are uppercased like single create;
duplicate SKUs in the batch reject the request, while a DB SKU
collision is a per-item CONFLICT. dryRun projects without
writing; atomic inserts every SKU in one transaction.

get.description:
Caller's own reviews with product context, newest first by
default. Sends {"data": [reviews], "meta": {page, limit, …}}.
Reads identity from the JWT (no id parameter, can't spoof others).
Returns one account wrapped in the standard {"data"} envelope.

post.description:
Verifies the signature, settles the order. No JWT — the
signature IS the authentication. Mounted on the open group.

get.description:
Caller's hearts with catalog snapshots, one page at a time.
Sends {"data": [items], "meta": {page, limit, …}}.

post.description: Idempotent: re-hearting succeeds silently.

Max 50 product ids. Unknown or inactive products are per-item
NOT_FOUND; already-hearted rows succeed with alreadyExists.
Duplicate ids reject the whole request. atomic inserts every
new link in one transaction.

Max 50 product ids (not wishlist row ids), matching single
DELETE /wishlist/{id}. Unknown products are per-item NOT_FOUND;
known-but-not-hearted rows succeed with alreadyRemoved. dryRun
reports wouldDelete without writing; atomic removes all rows in
one transaction.

images.description: Images excludes uploads that are still queued (empty url).

available.description:
Available is on-hand minus active reservations: the number a
shopper can add to the cart right now. Zero for a brand-new SKU
until an admin sets stock.

BearerAuth.description: JWT — paste with or without the "Bearer" prefix.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
